And in #67606 I realized that passing a non-URL to `is_hass_url` could cause `normalize_url` to raise `ValueError`. This fixes both.

issue_context.title: Integration: Home Assistant WebSocket API - Video casting issue
issue_context.body:
### The problem

I just updated to 2022.3.3 running hass on a pi. If I try to cast video from a camera or DLNA I get the error "Failed to call service media_player/play_media.". I cast audio to a chrome cast or a google home it works fine. When I power on a google chromecast the "welcome to home assistant" appears.


### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2022.3.3

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

Media / Casting / Websocket API

We should improve our error handling, This should be converted to a `HomeAssistantError`.

This is most likely caused because you have SSL configured in your Home Assistant instance but have not configured your external URLs correctly to start with HTTPS.

I have exactly the same error and it only appeared after I updated to 2022.3.5 from 2022.2.9 if I recall correctly. So I assume I have the SSL configured correctly since I didn't change anything else.

Check that you have configured your internal and external URLs correctly. You can find them here if you have advanced mode enabled:

[![Open your Home Assistant instance and show your general Home Assistant settings.](https://my.home-assistant.io/badges/general.svg)](https://my.home-assistant.io/redirect/general/)
